nodes.description: Public uint256 constant controlling seconds needed per shrimp; used in hatchEggs and getEggsSinceLastHatch (also caps accrual).
Public uint256 starting shrimp amount, dead configuration value.
Private trade-balancing numerator constant (10000) used in calculateTrade.
Private trade-balancing denominator constant (5000) used in calculateTrade.
Public bool activation flag; gates tokenFallback, hatchEggs and sellEggs and is set in seedMarket.
Public address of the CEO/developer, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as fee recipient.
Mapping holding each user's shrimp amount, updated in hatchEggs and read by getEggsSinceLastHatch.
Mapping of accrued but unclaimed eggs per user; reset to zero in hatchEggs/sellEggs and credited with referral share.
Mapping of last hatch timestamp per user, written with now and read to compute elapsed time.
Mapping of referrer address per user, set in hatchEggs and paid a fifth of eggsUsed.
Public market egg pool, seeded in seedMarket and mutated in hatchEggs/sellEggs.
Elyxr token contract address inherited from AcceptsElyxr; target of all external calls and the onlyTokenContract authorization anchor.
Constructor ElyxrShrimpFarmer(address) that assigns tokenContract (base) and sets ceoAddress to msg.sender.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether and does nothing.
External ERC677 hook restricted by onlyTokenContract; computes eggs bought, calls reinvest and tokenContract.transfer before crediting claimedEggs.
Public function converting eggs into shrimp, setting referrals, resetting claimedEggs, recording now and boosting marketEggs.
Public function selling accrued eggs, calling reinvest and transferring fee to CEO and remainder to msg.sender.
Public one-time seeding function requiring marketEggs==0 and msg.sender==ceoAddress to set initialized and marketEggs.
Public function that calls external tokenContract.myDividends and tokenContract.reinvest when dividends exceed 1.
Public view trade balancing algorithm combining PSN/PSNH constants with supplied reserves and balance.
Public view computing egg sale value from marketEggs and tokenContract.myTokens().
Public view computing eggs bought for a given token amount and contract balance.
Public view convenience wrapper calling calculateEggBuy with tokenContract.myTokens().
Public view returning 4/100 of an amount as the developer fee.
Public view returning hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
Public view summing claimedEggs[msg.sender] and getEggsSinceLastHatch(msg.sender).
Public view computing accrued eggs from block.timestamp minus lastHatch, capped by EGGS_TO_HATCH_1SHRIMP.
Public view returning tokenContract.myDividends(true).
Public view returning tokenContract.myTokens().
Internal view using assembly extcodesize to detect whether an address is a contract.
Private pure helper returning the smaller of two values.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, mapping indexes and payout destinations.
Block timestamp (now) used to accrue eggs and record lastHatch, miner-influenceable.
tokenContract.transfer(ceoAddress, devFee(_value)) executed in tokenFallback before claimedEggs is updated.
tokenContract.transfer to CEO and to msg.sender executed inside sellEggs after reinvest.
tokenContract.reinvest() external invocation inside reinvest, reachable from tokenFallback and sellEggs.
Unguarded tokenContract.myTokens() external call used for pricing in multiple functions.
tokenContract.myDividends(true) external call used in reinvest and getContractDividends.
Inline assembly extcodesize check in _isContract; bypassable during contract construction.
Chained multiply/divide arithmetic in calculateTrade sensitive to reserve manipulation and rounding.
Egg accrual derived from now - lastHatch, enabling timestamp manipulation of rewards.
Constructor parameter holding the Elyxr token address.
tokenFallback token sender address parameter.
tokenFallback token amount parameter used for buying eggs and dev fee.
tokenFallback ERC677 metadata parameter, unused.
hatchEggs referrer address parameter written into referrals.
seedMarket egg amount parameter assigned to marketEggs.
calculateTrade token reserve parameter.
calculateTrade egg reserve parameter.
calculateTrade balance parameter.
calculateEggSell egg amount parameter.
calculateEggBuy token amount parameter.
calculateEggBuy contract balance parameter.
calculateEggBuySimple token amount parameter.
devFee amount parameter.
getEggsSinceLastHatch address parameter.
_isContract address parameter passed to extcodesize.
min first comparison value.
min second comparison value.
Eggs computed and credited to claimedEggs[_from] in tokenFallback.
Token balance snapshot in tokenFallback used for pricing.
Eggs consumed in hatchEggs from getMyEggs.
Derived shrimp added to hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender] in hatchEggs.
Accrued eggs fetched in sellEggs.
Sale value of eggs in sellEggs.
Developer fee deducted in sellEggs.
Elapsed seconds computed from now and lastHatch in getEggsSinceLastHatch.
Extcodesize result in _isContract.

edges.reason: Constructor sets ceoAddress directly from msg.sender.
hatchEggs indexes referrals, hatcheryShrimp, claimedEggs and lastHatch by msg.sender.
sellEggs clears and pays out based on msg.sender.
seedMarket authorizes seeding by comparing msg.sender with ceoAddress.
getMyShrimp returns hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
getMyEggs aggregates data for msg.sender.
onlyTokenContract modifier requires msg.sender == address(tokenContract).
hatchEggs writes lastHatch[msg.sender]=now, a timestamp dependency.
sellEggs writes lastHatch[msg.sender]=now, a timestamp dependency.
getEggsSinceLastHatch derives rewards from now minus lastHatch.
calculateEggSell reads marketEggs as reserve.
getEggsSinceLastHatch multiplies elapsed time by hatcheryShrimp[adr].
getEggsSinceLastHatch reads lastHatch[adr].
tokenFallback queries and transfers through tokenContract.
reinvest reads tokenContract dividends and calls reinvest.
calculateEggSell prices using tokenContract.myTokens().
_value flows into devFee and the CEO transfer inside tokenFallback.
_from indexes claimedEggs when crediting eggsBought.
ref parameter is stored into referrals[msg.sender].
eggs parameter is assigned to marketEggs in seedMarket.
eggsBought is added to claimedEggs[_from].
eggsUsed is divided by EGGS_TO_HATCH_1SHRIMP to produce newShrimp.
hasEggs is passed to calculateEggSell to produce eggValue.
secondsPassed feeds the timestamp-dependent accrual of eggs.
tokenFallback executes external tokenContract.transfer before updating claimedEggs[_from].
tokenFallback invokes reinvest, an external call, before its state update.
sellEggs performs external tokenContract.transfer payouts.
sellEggs calls reinvest which makes further external calls.
reinvest calls external tokenContract.reinvest().
_isContract executes inline assembly extcodesize.
calculateTrade performs a chained arithmetic expression over reserves.
getEggsSinceLastHatch derives reward amounts from block timestamp.
seedMarket sets initialized to true, enabling game functions.
Constructor writes ceoAddress.
getMyEggs calls getEggsSinceLastHatch.
calculateEggSell delegates to calculateTrade.
calculateEggBuy delegates to calculateTrade.
calculateEggBuySimple delegates to calculateEggBuy.
The external token transfer can re-enter tokenFallback before claimedEggs[_from] is credited.
The external token transfer can re-enter sellEggs while payouts are in flight.
tokenContract.reinvest can call back into the farm, re-entering reinvest/tokenFallback.

calculateTrade reserve argument local to that function.
calculateTrade balance argument local to that function.

calculateEggBuy balance argument used only inside that function.
calculateEggBuySimple argument forwarded to calculateEggBuy.

getEggsSinceLastHatch address argument indexing lastHatch and hatcheryShrimp.
_isContract address argument passed to the extcodesize assembly.
min comparison argument.
min comparison argument.
Intermediate egg amount computed and credited inside tokenFallback.
Token balance snapshot taken inside tokenFallback for pricing.
Accrued eggs consumed inside hatchEggs.
Shrimp amount derived and stored inside hatchEggs.
Accrued egg total read inside sellEggs.
Sale value computed inside sellEggs.
Developer fee computed inside sellEggs.
Timestamp delta computed inside getEggsSinceLastHatch feeding the timestamp accrual.
Extcodesize result held inside _isContract.
